_readme: S742 (lane 1, readers). El Camino's Photography Certificate of Achievement 19883 is live on its own page (poid 3640, paid read 46007782666 through the site_pages pin), and its record adds to 25 where the page prints 'Total Units: 26-27'. total_differs is filed only from a page a session read (kb/program_total_differs.json). This read prints the certificate's own page as the capture reads it, so a session can read each course's units, the 'Required Core' figure, the '9 units from:' list and the total. One load, no model call, nothing written.

http_hosts.catalog.elcamino.edu: the registry's catalog address is http://catalog.elcamino.edu/, and the harvest's capture reads every program page at that address, so each filed source and record carries it; this read asks for the same page as filed

questions.figures: Each course the Photography certificate's page prints with its units, the figure it prints beside 'Required Core', the '9 units from:' list, and the total.
